nav.vault.title: Browse project groups and check files out and in
nav.requests.title: Change requests (ECR): report a problem, propose a change
settings.title: Settings
settings.appearance.hint: Choose how TeamCraft Desktop looks. The distribution skins are dark.
settings.language.hint: The language of the menus and messages of this app. Your data – item names, comments, file names – is never translated.
settings.language.saved: The language changes when the app starts again.
settings.donate_tag: Show the “Support us on Ko-fi” tag at start
settings.donate_tag.hint: TeamCraft is free software, developed by a non-profit association. The tag appears once per start in the status bar; a click opens ko-fi.com/warr_ev in your browser. Nothing is sent before you click.
donate.tag.title: Opens the Ko-fi page of the association that develops TeamCraft in your browser
empty.no_groups.editor: No project groups yet. Create one – you become its manager and add the others.
empty.no_groups.viewer: No project groups yet. CAD editors create them – ask a manager of a group to add you.
empty.group_empty: This project group has no items yet.
empty.group_empty.editor: Import an existing CAD folder or create a new item.
empty.group_empty.editor_web: Create a new item or import a BOM exported from your CAD program. TeamCraft Desktop imports a whole CAD folder.
empty.group_empty.viewer: The CAD editors of the group add its items; they show up here.
empty.group_empty.not_member: Only members of the group add items to it – ask a manager of the group to add you.
empty.no_checkouts: No check-outs. Check out a revision to change its files – it stays here until you check it in.
empty.no_checkouts.viewer: Nothing checked out – checking out needs the CAD editor role.
empty.nothing_to_review: Nothing to review. A change lands here when its author submits it and you are one of its reviewers.
empty.no_open_changes: No open changes. A change collects the revisions to release together; yours stay here until they are released or cancelled.
empty.no_open_changes.viewer: No open changes. CAD editors create changes – a change request of yours can become one.
empty.no_new_files: No new parts or assemblies in your working folder.
empty.no_new_files.get: Get a project group to copy its files here, then work on them in your CAD program.
empty.workspace_folder: The folder is empty – the revision has no files yet. Check it out, save its CAD files here and check them in.
empty.workspace_folder.mine: The folder is empty – the revision has no files yet. Save its CAD files here and check them in.
empty.workspace_folder.none: The folder is empty – the revision has no files yet.
empty.items.viewer: CAD editors create the items; you see the ones of your project groups here.
empty.viewer_note.title: Viewer account
empty.viewer_note: You can look at everything you may see and request changes. Editing – items, check-outs, changes – needs the CAD editor role: ask an administrator of this server.
onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.connected: Connected to {server} as {user} ({role}) – change in Settings → Account.
onboarding.folder.text: Your CAD files live in {dir} – each project group in its own folder.
onboarding.folder.later: Change it later in Settings → Workspace.
onboarding.folder.missing: The folder does not exist yet – the first Get or check-out creates it.
onboarding.cad.none: No CAD program found – you can still check out files and open them yourself from the working folder.
onboarding.group.question: Which group do you work in first?
onboarding.group.viewer: You can view and download files; checking out needs the CAD editor role.
onboarding.group.none.editor: You are not a member of a project group yet. Create one – you become its manager and add the others.
onboarding.group.none.viewer: You are not a member of a project group yet. Ask a group manager to add you – your user name is {login}.
onboarding.open.program: Check out and open locks it, copies it and its parts into {folder} and opens it in {program}.
onboarding.open.program_other: Check out and open locks it, copies it and its parts into {folder} and opens it in {program} – {wanted}, the group's version, is not installed on this computer.
onboarding.open.program_missing: Check out and open locks it and copies it and its parts into {folder}. The group works in {program}, which is not installed on this computer – the file opens in the program your system uses for it.
onboarding.open.any: Check out and open locks it, copies it and its parts into {folder} and opens it in the CAD program chosen for its file.
onboarding.open.viewer: Get… copies an item with its parts into {folder}; open it from there.
onboarding.open.show.title: Make {group} your group and open {number} – Check out and open is its next step
onboarding.open.show.viewer_title: Make {group} your group and open {number} – its files, structure and 3D preview
onboarding.open.failed: The assemblies of {group} could not be loaded: {error}
onboarding.open.none: {group} has no assembly to start with yet – its files are in Home.
onboarding.open.none_free: None of the assemblies of {group} is free and in work – they are released, in review or checked out. Open one in Home and revise it to start working on it.
onboarding.open.cad_setup: Your CAD program finds the parts of an assembly through its own project or search-path settings; your group manager sets them up once.
onboarding.open.cad_setup.link: How a group sets up its CAD programs
onboarding.tip.loop: A check-out only locks it – Cancel check-out undoes it without a new version. Save in your CAD program as usual, then Check in… here or in your worklist.
onboarding.tip.loop_done: This is your daily loop: Check out and open → save in CAD → Check in…
